PoolDestinationAddress.title: poolTo
PoolDestinationAddress.description: Destination address of the transaction, or `0x00` when the transaction creates a contract. A creation transaction carries an empty receive address, and the pool renders empty bytes as the sentinel `0x00` rather than as null. This is specific to the pool: `eth_getTransactionByHash` reports the same transaction's `to` as null.

oneOf.title: contractCreationSentinel
oneOf.description: The transaction creates a contract and has no destination address
